crew.overview: A down-on-his-luck crab fisherman embarks on a journey to get a young man with Down syndrome to a professional wrestling school in rural North Carolina and away from the retirement home where he’s lived for the past two and a half years.
crew.title: The Peanut Butter Falcon

details.biography: Lije Sarki is an American writer, director, and producer who started his career making skateboarding videos. Under his banner 1993, Sarki produced the indie breakout, The Peanut Butter Falcon and The Line.  He wrote, produced, and directed two films: Doug Out and Sweet Dreams. In addition, he launched GRAVEL alongside Jay Carson to develop and produce bold and original film and television projects.
details.name: Lije Sarki
